scrollbars.problemBody: macOS hides the scrollbar until you start scrolling, so a clipped list gives no sign it has more below. You either get no affordance or the wrong one.
scrollbars.scrollbarBody: The thumb rests narrow and low-contrast, then widens and darkens on hover so it stays quiet until you reach for it. Touch-primary devices use native overflow scrolling.
scrollbars.fadeBody: The baseline edge treatment is shadcn's scroll-fade, vendored as a CSS utility in globals.css. A mask dissolves content toward edges that have more to scroll, with no JavaScript.
scrollbars.horizontalBody: A row wider than its container, faded with the x variant.
scrollbars.doubleOverflowBody: A table taller and wider than its box. orientation=both adds both scrollbars and the corner.
scrollbars.p1: Classes for the inner scrolling viewport, where the scroll-fade utility goes.
scrollbars.p2: Classes for the outer container; set the height or width constraint here.
